source_evidence: Form ADV Part 3, referred to as the “relationship summary,” which advisers must provide to new clients and existing clients.
question: Misconception: An adviser only has to provide the Form ADV Part 3 relationship summary to new clients.
answer: Correction: The source says advisers must provide the relationship summary to both new and existing clients. It describes the firm’s services, fees and costs, conflicts of interest, required standard of conduct, disciplinary history, and key questions to ask the adviser.
